# Hugh Carrow & Wilfred Mott

- [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) — Rival of — [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md) — competitors seeking the favor of a young lady · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000)</sub>
- [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) — Friend of — [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md) — constant friends · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Park P11](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0011)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde walk to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school together while discussing their schoolmates and their beautiful surroundings. During afternoon classes, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her hair, prompting an enraged [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to smash her slate over his head.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038)_

> In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)_

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P4](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. > At school, Hugh silently competes with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while ignoring her, leaving her to regret her past harshness as the term ends. Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) reassures the class that she will return next year, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to happily lock away her books for summer vacation. Later, [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and compliments Nell's growth and grace despite her initial misgivings.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized

The Regent’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043)_

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) collapses and dies after receiving news of the bank failure, plunging [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) into mourning. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) grieves with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and converses with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) about life carrying on despite her loss. As routine returns, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat on the porch about friends, future plans, and Thirza's past romance.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P31](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0031)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) departs from [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after emotional goodbyes, traveling by train and ferry alongside Hugh and Wilfred. Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), she is greeted by [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), who escorts her to their new boardinghouse while chatting to brighten Nell's spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

> [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Hugh, and Wilfred on a walk through the park and along [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). During their walk, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a quiet conversation about life and grief before the group stops to admire a quaint, historic cottage called Tabby's Place.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VI In the Park

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).
>
> — v3 · Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.
>
